column1: # "You're not alone": battle lines for the "???" fight (battle/party_join.c).
# Shown as plain battle text at the bottom of the screen, which holds two
# lines: each message is at most two lines, with no {page_break} and no
# {end_wait}. A longer line is several messages, the later ones named ...2, ...3.

column3: Now. Show me what\nyou are on your own.
There. Look around you.\nNo one is coming.
Not because they won't.\nBecause they can't.
No. You're wrong.\nHe was never alone.
That's not possible.\nMy hold was perfect.
I didn't let him go\nalone that night.
I told you, Isaac.\nWe'd find a way.
I could hear you\nthe whole time.
I came to see the\noriginal. Alone.
Your healer was right.\nHe was never alone.
